_help: Extra questions asked during registration, after the name and PIN are saved.
Answers go to users.profile (JSON) under 'key'. Edit freely; restart the bot to apply.
type: 'text'   -> the LLM extracts the answer from what the caller said
type: 'digits' -> spoken or typed on the keypad (# to finish); min_len / max_len digits
type: 'choice' -> one of 'options' (the LLM maps the reply to one of them)
required: false lets the caller say 'skip'. 'ask' needs 'en'; 'hi' is optional.

ask.en: Which city are you calling from?
ask.hi: आप किस शहर से बात कर रहे हैं?

ask.en: Do you have another phone number we can reach you on? Say it, or type it and press hash. You can also say skip.
ask.hi: क्या आपका कोई दूसरा फ़ोन नंबर है? बोलिए, या टाइप करके हैश दबाइए। आप स्किप भी बोल सकते हैं।
